About the show

Matthew and the Atlas is the project of Hampshire-based songwriter Matt Hegarty — one of the first artists signed to Communion Records. Over fifteen years and seven albums, he has traversed a range of musical territories from classic acoustic folk to synth-laden electronica and guitar-led alt-rock...
